items.lede: New York’s lawsuit against the company is one of more than two dozen cases brought by states accusing the social media giant of designing its platform to encourage addictive use among children.
items.title: New York alleges TikTok gave teens, children a placebo safety feature instead of a real one

items.lede: New York is alleging that thousands of TikTok users, including kids and teens, were unknowingly given "ghost" versions of the platform's safety features rather than the working versions. Reuters reports the allegation is part of an "updated, sealed version" of New York's 2024 lawsuit against TikTok, which was "later ordered unsealed by a judge." According […]
items.title: New York accuses TikTok of serving users ‘placebo’ safety features
